countries.description_first_line: Coachi — heart rate voice coaching for your workouts
countries.description:
Coachi — heart rate voice coaching for your workouts

Coachi helps you train smarter with live voice guidance based on your heart rate, intensity, and workout type. Instead of constantly checking your phone or watch, you get coaching in your ear when you should slow down, hold your pace, or stay in your target heart rate zone.

Whether you run, walk, cycle, or do intervals, Coachi helps you stay focused and train with better control.

Live coaching while you train
Coachi follows your workout in real time and gives clear voice cues along the way. Get guidance, motivation, countdowns, and reminders that help you stay on track from start to finish.

Heart rate zone guidance
Connect Apple Watch or a supported heart rate monitor for more precise coaching. Coachi uses your heart rate to tell you when your intensity is too high, too low, or right where it should be.

Coachi Score after each workout
After your workout, you get a simple Coachi Score that shows how well you completed the session. The score uses heart rate, duration, distance, and workout data to help you understand your progress over time.

With Coachi, you can:
• Get live voice coaching during workouts
• Stay in the right heart rate zone without constantly checking your watch
• Choose between multiple coach voices
• Connect Apple Watch or a supported heart rate monitor
• Get motivation, countdowns, and guidance while you train
• View Coachi Score and workout history after each session
• Use Coachi for running, walking, cycling, intervals, and more

Coachi is free to download and use with a basic experience. Premium unlocks more advanced voice coaching, extended workout history, and extra features through optional monthly or yearly subscriptions.

Some features require access to Apple Health, microphone, notifications, or a supported heart rate device.

Restore Purchases is available on the subscription screen and in Profile → Settings → Restore Purchases.

Terms of Use: https://coachi.no/terms
Privacy Policy: https://coachi.no/privacy

Both links are also shown at the bottom of the subscription screen in the app.

public_page.subtitle: Voice Coaching by Heart Rate
public_page.short_description: Run smarter with Coachi, your fitness coach. Get voice guided workouts. Get help stay in the right zone, and know exactly what to improve after every run.

strengths: Public App Store page has a full iPhone screenshot shelf.

issues.title: App title casing reads unfinished
issues.detail: Live title is "Coachi: Voice fitness Coach".
issues.recommendation: Change the title casing in the next App Store metadata update. Keep it plain and runner-aligned.

issues.title: Title/subtitle do not claim running
issues.detail: Title/subtitle currently read "Coachi: Voice fitness Coach" / "Voice Coaching by Heart Rate".
issues.recommendation: Test a runner-specific title/subtitle such as Coachi: AI Run Coach or Coachi: Voice Run Coach.

issues.title: Description spreads the promise across run/walk/cycle/intervals
issues.detail: The current paid and organic push is runner-led, while the App Store copy frames Coachi as a general workout coach.
issues.recommendation: Make the first 2 lines runner-first: live cues during runs, heart-rate zones, Apple Watch/iPhone.

issues.title: Primary traffic country has 0 ratings
issues.detail: US lookup reports rating 0 from 0 users.
issues.recommendation: After the next real user win, ask for ratings from active iOS users before scaling cold traffic.

issues.title: Apple lookup API returns zero screenshots while public HTML has screenshots
issues.recommendation: Use public page parsing for listing audits and verify App Store Connect media by device size.

issues.title: First screenshot likely leads with setup, not the live coaching promise
issues.detail: First screenshot asset is Appstore_imave_v2.png. The visual audit shows the first frame says "Select your optimal heart rate".
issues.recommendation: Make screenshot 1 say what the user gets: Live AI run coaching in your ear.

issues.title: App Store Connect campaign attribution is incomplete
issues.detail: Coachi-side click tracking works, but redirected App Store URLs still lack pt.
issues.recommendation: Set APP_STORE_CAMPAIGN_PROVIDER_TOKEN in production before judging App Store Connect campaign performance.
